obernants.operator: Universe U is (u64 a,u64 p) x Result<Option<u64>,ModulusError>. For p<2 every output except InvalidModulus is absent; for composite p>=2 every output except CompositeModulus is absent. For prime p, errors, roots outside [0,p/2], wrong squares and None on a quadratic residue are absent; Some on a nonresidue is absent.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived mathematical target; finite executed correspondence is not proof
obernants.assumptions: Exact unsigned arithmetic and cited primality witness theorem

obernants.operator: Fix prime p and observed Some(r). Its fiber contains all u64 a congruent to r² mod p provided 0<=r<=p/2; the fiber is empty otherwise. None has all nonresidue classes. Without fixed p, retain the union over prime p. Errors discard a entirely, so every radicand is compatible with the indicated modulus class.
